data.name: Autoloo
data.detailed_description:
Autoloo is a fast-paced, auto-battling strategy game inspired by the armies of Waterloo.

Build your army. Position your troops. Press start.
Then watch history collide.

Designed for players who love the grand tactics of Total War but want matches that finish in under a minute, Autoloo delivers strategic depth in bite-sized battles.

Recruit infantry, cavalry, artillery, and elite units from a Napoleonic-era roster.
Each unit has unique stats, strengths, and abilities.

Will you field disciplined line infantry backed by cannon fire?
Shock the enemy with heavy cavalry?
Or craft a clever hybrid formation that counters the meta?

Positioning and composition are everything.

Your objective is simple:

Achieve 10 wins before taking 3 losses.
(Draws don’t count.)

Each battle pits your army against a lineup built by another real player.
When you click Start Battle, your formation is sent to the database to challenge others in return.

You’re not fighting bots.
You’re fighting the meta.

Autoloo uses asynchronous PvP:

  • Face armies designed by real players

  • No waiting for matchmaking

  • No long queues

  • Instant battles

En avant!
